The core is probably in the wrong state rather than mistuned. A 0.70 V/V line regulation at 0.79 V points to the ΔVBE loop itself. The only ~54 mV across R1 is being swamped by Vds‑dependent errors: M2 DIBL and M4 gds both see the full VDD swing. Refining parameters can't fix that, so the topology needs to change.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Line reg 0.7 V/V: M2 drain and M4 drain track VDD 1:1, so DIBL/gds changes swamp the 54 mV ΔVBE. Add composite (self-cascode) devices on M2, M4, M5; raise the Q ratio to 1:24; longer L; trim the start-up sense branch."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (0.4e-6, 0.25e-6, 0.6e-6),  # core branch current (each)
    "ko":     (1.5, 1.0, 2.5),            # output-branch current ratio Io/I
    "vptat":  (0.58, 0.45, 0.70),         # Io*R2 (PTAT term) at 27 C
    "vtgt":   (0.95, 0.92, 0.98),         # Vref target used to set divider R4
    "gmid_p": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),
    "L_p":    (3.0, 1.5, 6.0),
    "gmid_n": (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),
    "L_n":    (3.0, 1.0, 6.0),
    "kc":     (5.0, 3.0, 10.0),           # self-cascode W ratio bottom/top
    "Rsu":    (20e6, 8e6, 40e6),          # start-up sense pull-down
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    I = p["I"]; Io = p["ko"] * I
    m1, m2 = 1, 24
    kc = p["kc"]

    def veb(Ie, m):
        return 0.76 + UT * math.log(max(Ie, 1e-12) / (m * 10e-6))

    # Core PTAT: Veb1 = Veb2 + I*R1
    R1 = UT * math.log(m2 / m1) / I
    veb1 = veb(I, m1)

    # Output branch: Vref = (Veb3 + Io*R2) * R4/(R2+R4)
    R2 = p["vptat"] / Io
    vt = p["vtgt"]
    iq3 = 0.5 * Io
    for _ in range(30):
        veb3 = veb(iq3, 1)
        iq3 = max((vt - veb3) / R2, 0.05 * Io)
    veb3 = veb(iq3, 1)
    R4 = vt * R2 / max(veb3 + p["vptat"] - vt, 1e-3)

    # Devices
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], I, vds=0.4, vsb=veb1)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], I, vds=0.6)
    mpo = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], Io, vds=0.3)
    mps = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], 0.25 * I, vds=0.3)
    Wnc = max(mn.W / kc, 0.42)
    Wpc = max(mp.W / kc, 0.42)
    Wpoc = max(mpo.W / kc, 0.42)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # PNP core
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=m1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=m2)
    n.R("R1", "s2", "e2", R1)
    # NMOS level-shift pair: M1 diode, M2 self-cascoded (M2c shields M2 drain from VDD)
    n.dev("M1", "ng", "ng", "e1", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "ng", "s2", "vss", mn)
    n.M("M2c", "pg", "ng", "d2", "vss", "nfet", Wnc, p["L_n"])
    # PMOS mirror: M3 diode, M4 self-cascoded
    n.dev("M3", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "d4", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.M("M4c", "ng", "pg", "d4", "vdd", "pfet", Wpc, p["L_p"])
    # Output branch, self-cascoded source
    n.dev("M5", "d5", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mpo)
    n.M("M5c", "vref", "pg", "d5", "vdd", "pfet", Wpoc, p["L_p"])
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    n.R("R4", "vref", "vss", R4)
    # Start-up: sx low when the core is off -> MS1 injects current into ng
    n.dev("MS4", "sx", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mps)
    n.R("RSU", "sx", "vss", p["Rsu"])
    n.M("MS1", "ng", "sx", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 2.0)

    power = VDD * (2 * I + Io + 0.25 * I)
    vref = (veb3 + p["vptat"]) * R4 / (R2 + R4)
    # Line regulation: residual mirror error through cascode-attenuated gds
    gain_c = max(mp.gm / max(mp.gds, 1e-15), 10.0)
    dI_rel = (mp.gds / I) / gain_c + 0.01 / (UT * math.log(m2 / m1)) / gain_c
    line_reg = p["vptat"] * dI_rel * R4 / (R2 + R4) + 0.003
    psrr = -db(max(line_reg, 1e-4))
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": 200.0, "power": power,
               "line_reg": line_reg, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
```
